description: Auth failure surge — 401/403 spike from API clients
evidence_text: Nginx access log analysis: 401 auth_failure errors: 892 in last 5 minutes (baseline: 8/5min). 403 Forbidden: 234. Dominant error class: auth_failure. Source IPs: distributed (top IP only 12% of requests). HMAC signature validation failed at gateway for 87% of 401s. Possible credential rotation issue.
